verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst lets business users ask questions in natural language and get answers without writing SQL. The homepage markets CoWork ("Ask anything") and CoCo ("Build anything"), and the managed MCP server exposes Cortex Analyst, Agents and SQL execution as tools for AI agents. However, the documented natural-language capability covers data querying/analytics rather than operating the platform itself (managing warehouses, roles, pipelines, deployments). The CoWork/CoCo claims are marketing taglines only. missing for 10: documented natural-language administration/operation of platform resources, detail on CoCo/CoWork capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
